events.text: Doctrine: Take west crossing (F1) in first 5 watches. I hold F1 with both inf units. Since I hold F1, I should now act on mail/hunt riders. No mail, so I will scout/move units to intercept potential enemy movement.

events.text: It is Watch 6. My doctrine says take F2 (middle crossing) in the first five watches, which I missed. I must now secure F2 and push towards holding two fords. Tiger has units at s-mid (2w ago). I will move my forces to secure F2 and screen against Tiger.
